claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Ubenimex at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive as a direct cytotoxic agent; its aminopeptidase/CD13 inhibition and immunomodulatory effects require higher concentrations or immune effector cells, and the pooled 5-day viability screen lacks immune components.
